title: Calendar/Schedule View
content: Build calendar interface. Views: month grid, week view, day view with toggle. Month: 7-column grid with day cells, event dots or previews. Week: 7 columns with hour rows, events as blocks. Day: single column with detailed hour slots. Navigation: previous/next, today button. Event display: colored blocks with title. Click event: opens detail popover.

variants.simple: Create calendar view with month, week, and day layouts.
variants.detailed: Build calendar interface. Views: month grid, week view, day view with toggle. Month: 7-column grid with day cells, event dots or previews. Week: 7 columns with hour rows, events as blocks. Day: single column with detailed hour slots. Navigation: previous/next, today button. Event display: colored blocks with title. Click event: opens detail popover.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive calendar interface with multiple views and event management. Header: flex justify-between items-center p-4 border-b. Navigation: prev/next buttons (ChevronLeft/ChevronRight), today button ("Today"), current date display (month/year or date range). View toggle: Month/Week/Day buttons or segmented control. Actions: "New Event" button, settings dropdown. Month view: grid-cols-7 for days of week. Header row: day names (Sun-Sat or Mon-Sun based on locale). Day cells: aspect-square or min-h-24, border, position relative. Cell header: day number (font-medium, text-gray-400 if other month, text-blue-600 if today with bg-blue-100 circle). Events: event pills showing time and title, truncated, "+N more" link if overflow. Different colors per calendar/category. Today: highlighted cell background. Click day: opens day view or quick-add event. Week view: grid with hour rows and day columns. Header: day names with dates. Time column: hour labels (12 AM - 11 PM, or 24h format). Day columns: relative position, full height. Events: positioned absolutely based on start time and duration, width spans column, colored blocks with time and title. Overlapping events: side by side or stacked. Current time: horizontal red line indicator. Day view: single day with hour rows, more detail per event. Hour rows: border-b, min-h-16. Events: positioned by time, full width, detailed view with description. Current hour: highlighted. Event component: bg-[color]-100 border-l-4 border-[color]-500 rounded px-2 py-1, click opens event detail. Event detail popover/modal: title, date/time, location, description, attendees, edit/delete actions. Create event: click empty time slot opens quick-add form, or "New Event" opens full form. Event form: title, date/time pickers, all-day toggle, location, description, repeat options, calendar/category selector, attendees. Drag-and-drop: move events by dragging, resize by dragging edges, visual feedback during drag. Recurring events: display recurring event instances. Mini calendar: sidebar month view for quick date navigation. Calendar list: sidebar showing different calendars with visibility toggles. Mobile: day view default, swipe to change days, bottom sheet for event details. Accessibility: keyboard navigation through dates, events announced with full details, focus management.
